wire_compatibility.router_wire: mycelium.router_wire.v1: 4-byte header length, canonical JSON envelope, message_type/body/payload_length/payload_sha256, then raw payload; 1 MiB header and 256 MiB payload ceilings
wire_compatibility.native_wire: MYA2 v2: fixed 112-byte activation header plus raw payload; MYR2 fixed 72-byte receipt; 64 MiB payload ceiling
wire_compatibility.decision: Production adapter must carry or reproduce the exact Router wire contract and add a message/action discriminator. Byte-level compatibility cannot be inferred from shared SHA-256 use.

router_contract_mapping.sync_async_impedance: Python TransportPort methods are synchronous; native implementation is Tokio async. A bounded bridge with explicit completion/error semantics is required. No FFI, subprocess protocol, or Rust-native Router integration exists in reviewed source.

router_request_control_plane.required_path: Authenticated point-to-point Router transport, not Gossip

static_confirmation.scope_limit: Static source reachability only. Native tests were not executed and no production adapter exists, so this is not an end-to-end runtime claim.

authentication.connection_security: Iroh supplies cryptographic endpoint identity and exposes connection.remote_id().
authentication.server_authorization: absent; server accepts any peer that reaches endpoint and negotiates ALPN
authentication.client_trust_binding: insufficient; client trusts mutable ready JSON EndpointAddr and checks only ready schema, mode, and ALPN
authentication.persistent_identity: absent in native source; Endpoint builder is not given a persisted SecretKey
authentication.production_requirement: Bind stable Iroh endpoint IDs to trusted Mycelium node IDs and authorize both inbound peer and requested destination.

transport_behavior.peer_identity: Connection evidence records remote endpoint ID, but no comparison against trusted membership/topology occurs.

stream_framing.calibration: Each sample uses one bidirectional stream: 16-byte MYC2 request, EOF, 32-byte MYS2 response, EOF.
stream_framing.per_message: One bidirectional stream per activation: 112-byte MYA2 header, exact payload_length bytes, EOF; 72-byte MYR2 receipt, EOF.
stream_framing.persistent: One bidirectional data stream per run: repeated MYA2 header plus payload frames; repeated 72-byte receipts; fixed external count determines termination; EOF after count.
stream_framing.done: Separate bidirectional stream with 8-byte MYD2 request and 8-byte MYE2 response.
stream_framing.dispatch: Stream purpose is positional/stateful; no generic stream/message type discriminator.

transport_behavior.retry: No connect, stream, message, or receipt retry policy. Errors abort run.
transport_behavior.cancellation: No cancellation token, Router path cancellation message, stream reset policy, or cancellation acknowledgement.

present: 45 seconds waiting for relay endpoint online
5 seconds best-effort wait for connection close

backpressure.per_message: Client starts at most window 1/2/4 send futures; server semaphore limits concurrent activation processing. Permit is released after validation, before delayed receipt write.
backpressure.persistent: Sequential writer plus mpsc channels sized to count; no Router work/byte limit or retry-after result.
backpressure.transport_layer: Iroh/QUIC flow control applies implicitly, but no application-level policy is surfaced.

connection_reuse.within_run: One Iroh connection is reused for calibration, all activation streams, and done handshake.
connection_reuse.per_message_mode: New bidirectional stream per activation on same connection.
connection_reuse.persistent_mode: One bidirectional activation stream on same connection.
connection_reuse.across_requests_or_runs: None; no pool, cache, reconnect, health check, idle expiry, or concurrent peer manager.
